findings.claim: The fate of client_document_defaults contradicts itself: Scope and Constraints say migration 0040 deletes the old table, while Step 4, the Migration Plan and AC10 define 0040 as a rename to client_document_defaults_legacy that keeps the data, so an implementer cannot tell whether a drop or a rename is required.
findings.command: grep -n "0040\|zrušení staré tabulky\|tabulku po kontrole smaže" .aid-o/work/evidence/P998/cp1/round-1/packet/plan.md
findings.fix: State one behaviour everywhere: 0040 renames the table to client_document_defaults_legacy (the data is kept, the table is not dropped), and change Scope line 58 and Constraints line 1179 to match.

findings.claim: AC7 checks that `_navod.txt` appears in export/router.py, but Step 12 puts the file generation in the new export/manifest.py (build_navod), so the AC can pass on just a filename string while the manifest builder is missing or broken.
findings.fix: Point AC7 at backend/acta/export/manifest.py with regex `def build_navod`, or turn it into a cmd AC that runs backend/tests/export/test_manifest.py.
